quotes.speaker: Cyro Asseo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo never formally requested a trade from the Milwaukee Bucks
quotes.excerpt: He never formally requested a trade. He didn't want to leave Milwaukee.
quotes.quote: Giannis Antetokounmpo never formally requested a trade. He didn't want to leave Milwaukee. It was this secret tug-of-war behind the scenes that felt like it had been going on for the last two years when it was finally going to happen. He went to South Beach, down here in Miami, and I've been fortunate enough to have covered him over the last six months.

quotes.speaker: Cyro Asseo
quotes.summary_phrase: Milwaukee Bucks and Giannis Antetokounmpo were in a failing relationship
quotes.excerpt: Milwaukee was like that girlfriend that you both know it's over, but you just keep going through the motions.
quotes.quote: Milwaukee was like that girlfriend that you both know it's over, but you just keep going through the motions because you still have love for each other, but you're not in love with each other anymore. You know it's not going to be a long-term fit in the future and the future isn't bright, but you just don't want to hurt each other.

quotes.speaker: Sam Yip
quotes.summary_phrase: Bucks were desperate to trade Giannis Antetokounmpo due to team struggles
quotes.excerpt: We were kind of fed up with how long it was lasting, especially last season.
quotes.quote: We were kind of fed up with how long it was lasting, especially last season. They just kept going on and on about how he wanted to be traded and all of a sudden he would publicly say, 'No, I don't want to get traded.' It reminded me a lot of Kevin Garnett in Minnesota, that time when he didn't publicly say he wanted to get traded, but I think we all kind of knew.

quotes.speaker: Cyro Asseo
quotes.summary_phrase: Anthony Davis trade request was inevitable for the New Orleans Pelicans
quotes.excerpt: For a while, we felt like it was inevitable that Davis would ultimately ask out.
quotes.quote: For a while, we felt like it was inevitable that Davis would ultimately ask out, which he did ahead of the 2018-2019 trade deadline, saying that he would not sign an extension, which kick-started the sweepstakes for AD. The Lakers weren't actually the front-runners at all. Somebody by the name of LeBron James ended up going there.

quotes.speaker: Cyro Asseo
quotes.summary_phrase: Anthony Davis failed to become an MVP candidate with the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: Anthony Davis was supposed to become an MVP and take the torch from LeBron.
quotes.quote: Anthony Davis was supposed to become an MVP and take the torch from LeBron. It was supposed to go from LeBron, this being LeBron's team, maybe for the first two years, and then AD was basically going to be the torchbearer and this was going to become Anthony Davis' team and he was supposed to be a perennial MVP candidate.

quotes.speaker: Sam Yip

text_blocks.speaker: Cyro Asseo
text_blocks.text: How was that being communicated to you in real time? Like, it was all out there, like the trade is done, you're going to the Lakers, and then it was like everybody reacting like, 'Oh, this is about to be crazy, CP with Kobe.'

text_blocks.speaker: Chris Paul
text_blocks.text: I was on the phone with my brother, my agent, and all that. We were figuring out a plan to get us to New Orleans, to get us to LA. My agent clicked over, said, 'Hold on,' clicked over, and then he came back on and he was like stuttering. We were hot. Me and Kobe talked, we had talked already and all that, and it was, it was a lot.

quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Paul discusses the failed trade to the Los Angeles Lakers

quotes.speaker: Sam Yip
quotes.summary_phrase: Lamar Odom's performance declined after the failed trade
quotes.excerpt: After that, he kind of mentally checked out and his stats really plummeted.
quotes.quote: Lamar Odom, I believe he was good up to the point where that thing happened and after that, he kind of mentally checked out and his stats really plummeted. And he was never really able to, LeBron was never really able to pass the torch to him and then, obviously, the Lakers went ahead and traded him for Luka.

quotes.speaker: Cyro Asseo
quotes.summary_phrase: Scottie Pippen was underpaid compared to Michael Jordan
quotes.excerpt: Michael Jordan had been the highest-paid player in all of basketball. Pippen was making 2.3 million.
quotes.quote: Michael Jordan had been the highest-paid player in all of basketball. Pippen was making 2.3 million, which was the 128th highest-paid player in the league. So you can understand after winning back-to-back-to-back championships, they, this led to him, or winning back-to-back-to-back championships and before winning back-to-back-to-back championships, he demanded a trade request which ultimately led to him being traded to the Portland Trail Blazers.

quotes.speaker: Sam Yip
quotes.summary_phrase: Scottie Pippen was past his prime when traded to Portland
quotes.excerpt: When Pippen finally got traded, he was already what, like 33 years old, so he was past his prime.
quotes.quote: When Pippen finally got traded, he was already what, like 33 years old, so he was past his prime at that point. And so his, I mean, his numbers plummeted from, I believe his last year with Chicago, his first year with Chicago, he was averaging 19 points and in MVP discussion, and then when he went to Houston for 40 or 50 games, his number is points per average per game dropped to 14.5.

quotes.speaker: Cyro Asseo
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard's trade request was a gamble that paid off
quotes.excerpt: He had openly said, 'I'm not going to stay in Toronto.' Ironically, now he's back in Toronto.
quotes.quote: He had openly said, 'I'm not going to stay in Toronto.' Ironically, now he's back in Toronto. It's the definition of betting on yourself and also a team betting on a player, believing that they were just one piece away from a championship. You see this more in like football, American football, the team's successfully trading for a player and it paying off on a one-year rental.

quotes.speaker: Sam Yip
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard's trade changed the landscape of the NBA
quotes.excerpt: That whole trade changed the whole NBA at that point, right? No one could be Toronto.
quotes.quote: That whole trade changed the whole NBA at that point, right? No one could be Toronto was finding a way to be LeBron in the East. LeBron leaves, they get Kawhi, and then they run the East. Well, they didn't run it because they did, they got back the Sixers by Kawhi hitting that infamous, that crazy, the shot that bounced everywhere on the rim.

quotes.speaker: Cyro Asseo
quotes.summary_phrase: Shaquille O'Neal knew a trade was coming after the Lakers lost
quotes.excerpt: I knew it was going to be a change because I've been around long enough to know how stuff is going to go.
quotes.quote: I knew it was going to be a change because I've been around long enough to know how stuff is going to go. I wasn't born yesterday. I wasn't born yesterday, so I know how stuff's going to go. Now they say they're going to do something and then when they don't do it, then they start back-talking. Somebody's going to make a change.

quotes.speaker: Cyro Asseo

text_blocks.speaker: Wilt Chamberlain
text_blocks.text: Well, actually, my request from Mr. Irvin Kosloff was that if we could not reach a financial agreement, that if he could possibly talk to the Los Angeles Lakers, this was my desire.

text_blocks.speaker: Wilt Chamberlain
text_blocks.text: Well, actually, I honestly gave a good try to consummate a deal with the 76ers, and after we found it was impossible, then this is the direction which I wanted to come.

quotes.summary_phrase: Wilt Chamberlain requested a trade to the Lakers

quotes.speaker: Sam Yip
quotes.summary_phrase: Wilt Chamberlain's trade to the Lakers was a career achievement
quotes.excerpt: It's almost like it was a career achievement, lifetime achievement award, like championship for that team.
quotes.quote: It's almost like it was a career achievement, lifetime achievement award, like championship for that team, for all the guys involved. And it didn't work. It didn't work. He ends up getting traded to the Portland Trail Blazers.

quotes.speaker: Cyro Asseo

text_blocks.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
text_blocks.text: Kobe, you're still under contract with them. Are you saying right here on this show that you wanna be traded?

text_blocks.speaker: Kobe Bryant
text_blocks.text: Yeah, I would, I would like to be traded, yeah. Yeah, I would like to be traded and it's, it's tough as it is to say that.

text_blocks.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
text_blocks.text: Is there anything that the Los Angeles Lakers could do to make you change your mind and decide that you do not want to be traded?

quotes.summary_phrase: Kobe Bryant publicly requests a trade from the Lakers

quotes.speaker: Cyro Asseo

text_blocks.speaker: Steve Patterson
text_blocks.text: I think all we can do is is refer to the long-standing history of Hakeem and the constant renegotiation demands and trade demands that he's made over the history of this franchise since he's been here.

text_blocks.speaker: Steve Patterson
text_blocks.text: Those came to a head earlier in the week. His last statement to us was that we were not willing to renegotiate the deal and he was going to have to do what he had to do and we were going to have to do what we had to do.

quotes.summary_phrase: Hakeem Olajuwon had a history of trade demands with the Rockets

quotes.speaker: Sam Yip
quotes.summary_phrase: Hakeem Olajuwon's trade demand led to two championships for the Rockets
quotes.excerpt: If he didn't request the trade, do you guys have two championships?
quotes.quote: If he didn't request the trade, do you guys have two championships? There's a lot, you know, like, and it seems, it sounds like they aired the grievances about like what one side wanted and what the other side wanted, and then to the point where, like you said, like he improved his game and was willing to pass the ball and stuff and got his, the rest like the Ralph Sampsons and the Sam Cassells and Kenny Smiths and all those other guys like to rally around and become.

quotes.speaker: Sam Yip
quotes.summary_phrase: Magic Johnson's trade request led to Pat Riley becoming coach
quotes.excerpt: It pretty much talks about the timeline from Paul Westhead was a coach, Magic Johnson wasn't feeling it.
quotes.quote: It pretty much talks about the timeline from Paul Westhead was a coach, Magic Johnson wasn't feeling it, and then Pat Riley like going from like a broadcaster and then eventually to becoming coach and that kind of started up Pat Riley's whole career as a coach and executive.

quotes.speaker: Sam Yip
quotes.summary_phrase: Magic Johnson's trade request was an early example of player empowerment
quotes.excerpt: This is kind of like the very beginning ages of the player empowerment movement in the NBA.
quotes.quote: This is kind of like the very beginning ages of the player empowerment movement in the NBA in terms of the player just being like, 'Look, like I don't want to play for this coach. If you don't, if you want to keep this coach, you go ahead and trade me.' And then the Lakers, Jerry Buss again, like he, he saw like Magic Johnson was a guy I brought here, so why would I keep Paul Westhead and like let, no, I'm just going to get rid of the coach and make sure Magic Johnson is happy.

quotes.speaker: Sam Yip
quotes.summary_phrase: Kareem Abdul-Jabbar's trade request cemented his legacy with the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: He won five more titles after that. That cemented his legacy.
quotes.quote: He won five more titles after that. That cemented his legacy. If that trade does not go through, I don't think he would have won five more championships. I do think this is probably one of the, this is the best trade request in terms of he got what he wanted and the Lakers got what they wanted.
